summary: Tested DataVision iteration 28 features: Email Preferences UI, User Referral System, and App.js refactoring. All 23 backend API tests passed. Fixed 2 bugs: 1) /api/projects validation error (FieldForce TEST_ data schema mismatch), 2) referral invite not checking admins collection. Frontend testing confirmed all extracted pages working correctly.

minor.issue: Email service has incorrect kwargs (html instead of html_content) - email sending fails silently but invite is still created

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed /api/projects - added filter to exclude FieldForce projects (different schema with 'name' instead of 'title')
Fixed referral_routes.py - now checks both datavision_users AND admins collections for existing users
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Email Preferences at /settings - 10 categories, 3 tabs (Notifications/Account/Security), global unsubscribe, quiet hours, 2) User Referral Dashboard at /referrals - stats, referral code, invite modal, credit history, 3) Extracted pages (AboutPage, ProjectsPage, NewsPage) all loading correctly from /pages/

features_verified.email_preferences_api: WORKING - GET/PUT /api/email-preferences/, bulk update, unsubscribe-all, resubscribe, reset-to-defaults
features_verified.email_preferences_ui: WORKING - /settings shows 10 categories, mandatory tags on security/billing, frequency dropdowns
features_verified.referral_stats_api: WORKING - GET /api/referrals/my-stats returns totals, credits earned/available/used
features_verified.referral_code_api: WORKING - GET /api/referrals/my-code returns 8-char code, referral links, reward amounts ($10 signup, $25 purchase, $5 referee)
features_verified.referral_dashboard_ui: WORKING - /referrals shows stats cards, referral link, invite modal, How It Works section
features_verified.about_page: WORKING - /about loads from /pages/AboutPage.jsx with Our Story, Our Values, Mission/Vision
features_verified.news_page: WORKING - /news loads from /pages/NewsPage.jsx with news articles
features_verified.homepage: WORKING - / loads from /pages/HomePage.jsx with hero, navigation

bugs_fixed./api/projects_500_error: Fixed by adding filter { title: { $exists: true } } to exclude FieldForce projects with different schema
bugs_fixed.referral_invite_existing_user: Fixed by checking both datavision_users and admins collections
